# Update fixture: one day of changes

> **TEST FIXTURE — not supplied data.** Written by the team to demonstrate update correctness,
> because the organizers supplied a static dump (problem statement, "Architecture freedom").

Specification: `docs/contracts/freshness_policy.md` (`fresh-0.2`) section 6. Test:
`ml/tests/pipelines/gold/test_incremental_update.py`. The fixture is self-contained; the test runs
on a clean clone without `ml/data/`.

## Layout

| Path | Content |
|---|---|
| `raw/base/` | Day N (partition 2026-06-17 loaded). Laid out like `ml/data/01_raw/`. |
| `raw/delivery_20260618/` | Day N+1 delivery, laid out like `ml/data/01_raw/`. The test copies it on top of `raw/base/`. |
| `expected/` | Expected gold state after loading base, then 2026-06-18 (section 6.3). Written by hand from the contract, not generated by the pipeline. |

## Provenance

`raw/base/` holds real rows of the synthetic dataset for customer `CLI-X7VXKV9P7ZC6` (Colombia,
Basic): the customer, its three products (two COP credit cards and one personal loan, which gold
must leave out) and 3 of its 29 card transactions. In the raw files:

- Personal columns (document number, names, email, phones, address) are `FIXTURE`, and
  `date_of_birth` is empty.
- Each `product_number` is replaced with a test number that keeps the real last 4 digits
  (`4000000000009205`, `4000000000007921`, `LOAN-00008811`).
- All other values are copied unchanged, in the raw CSV format (UTF-8 BOM, LF line endings).

`raw/delivery_20260618/` is made up:

1. `products/updates/year=2026/month=06/day=18/products_20260618.csv`: card 7921
   (`PRD-I97V8EFELBUP`) identical to its base row except `product_status = Blocked`,
   `last_updated = 2026-06-18 15:10:00` and an empty `last_transaction_date`.
2. `transactions/year=2026/month=06/day=18/transactions_20260618.csv`: one new purchase,
   `TRX-FIXTURE0000000000001`, on the other card, 9205. The ID is absent from the supplied data.

`expected/cards.csv` holds `card_number_hmac` values computed with the test key
`fixture-card-hash-key` (`HMAC-SHA256` over the UTF-8 card number, lowercase hex). That key is not
a secret and is used only by the tests.

These rows appear in no evaluation result.
